caveats.single_labeller_each_bucket: two labellers exist per bucket; each bucket figure here is the second labeller's alone, and agreement between the two is measured in inter_labeller_agreement.json, not assumed here
caveats.three_samples_not_one: each bucket share comes from its own n=60 sample; the three intervals are not independent of each other and are not a joint estimate
caveats.shares_multiplied_into_populations: point estimates of a share are applied to a fixed population count; no design effect and no finite-population correction is applied
caveats.citation_precision_unmeasured: the numerator counts units the register matched; the precision of those matches is not measured here, so this is an estimate of coverage, not a published rate
caveats.rate_publication_gate: operator policy: a published rate needs recall AND precision >= 0.9; this file does not meet that gate and must be cited as an estimate with its range
caveats.what_would_close_it: a second independent labeller on all three sheets, plus a measured citation-precision sample
